creative_originality.evidence: The whole idea is an opacity fade: t=0.00 empty, t=0.45 the complete wordmark in flat mid-grey, t=0.88 near-black, t=1.33 full black. Letters, dots and joins never move independently, so the same clip would fit any logo in any script. Nothing comes from the Arabic forms.

motion_quality.evidence: The fade is clean and artefact-free, but it is over by about 1.33s. Frames t=1.77 to t=3.98 (roughly 2.6s, two thirds of the clip) are identical static holds. No easing, overlap or secondary motion is visible, and the dead tail makes the pacing feel unfinished.

brand_relevance.evidence: Nothing contradicts a 'next-generation marketing studio', but nothing expresses it either. The fade is neutral and ignores right-to-left reading, the kashida stretch and the dot system. The wordmark appears all at once instead of being written or built.

visual_clarity.evidence: Every frame from t=0.45 on shows the complete, correctly joined, correctly dotted word, centred with generous margins. The final frame matches official.png exactly. The only cost is the faint grey state at t=0.45.

technical_quality.evidence: export validation, page errors, determinism, flashes, pops, handoffs
